test_result: All three listed gates replayed against persisted source at O0/O2 with identical transcripts, bounds checks and invalid/zero/overflow traps; PASS. No production admission implied.
scope: Opt-in candidate residual/diagonal exchange application and private deep-copy capture of the actual applied vector. Existing provider ABI and production HeadCalc are unchanged.
identity: Lineage, committed revision, trial attempt and residual evaluation identify the captured vector. Exact finite head identity is checked before application. The owner must issue unique attempt/evaluation identifiers; this helper is not an authority that allocates identifiers.
units: Positive rate enters matrix in cm/day; candidate amount is captured rate times captured dt in days. Derivative is subtracted from the matrix diagonal only when caller enables the source branch.
failure_semantics: Invalid residual evaluation leaves residual unchanged and invalidates previous scratch. Wrong identity returns no integrated amount. Explicit discard clears scratch. Nonfinite, shape and arithmetic-overflow guards reject before the corresponding operation.
tests: 512 dyadic source-sign residual and diagonal subtractions; captured rate-to-amount identity
Deep copy protects used vector from later input mutation; derivative-disabled branch preserves diagonal
Foreign lineage/revision/attempt/evaluation, head mismatch, NaN, shape mismatch, subtraction/integration overflow
Retry with changed dt uses new integrated amount; discard prevents transfer extraction
Actual A3 interval candidate mass gate consumes applied-vector amount: wrong-cell same-total exchange rejects, corrected retry commits isolated DTO
limitations: This helper is not wired into HeadCalc. Tests supply exchange/derivative and identity; they do not solve Richards, compute macrorate physics, establish matrix geometry or surface partition, or commit a whole column. Amount extraction is a candidate diagnostic, not an accepted receipt. A3 proposed reference corrections remain unadmitted.
next_action: Bind a source-derived nonlinear exchange evaluator and explicit geometry/surface trial inputs to the Richards owner; preserve exact final-used evaluation through backtracking and whole-column acceptance. Do not enable production by removing guards alone.
